questions.prompt: Which guardrail is on the list in the Claude docs guide to customer support?

options.text: Answer every question, even when it is off topic
options.explanation: The guide says the opposite: stay on topic and steer back to it.

options.text: Avoid promises the agent is not authorized to make
options.explanation: Right. The guide puts this rule in its list of guardrails.

options.text: Reply only in English, whatever language is used
options.explanation: The guide says Claude can hold conversations in over 200 languages. Language is not one of its guardrails.

questions.prompt: The Claude docs on ticket routing say tickets can be sorted by what?

options.text: The length of the customer's name
options.explanation: The guide does not sort by this. It sorts by things like intent and urgency.
Right. The guide also names prioritization.

options.text: The hour the email first arrived
options.explanation: The guide does not sort by this. It sorts by things like intent and urgency.

questions.prompt: What do the OpenAI docs on safety say prompt engineering can help with?

options.text: Making every answer true without any checks
options.explanation: The page does not promise this. It still recommends human review.

options.text: Removing the need to test the tool at all
options.explanation: The page also recommends testing the tool with many kinds of input.

options.text: Keeping answers on topic and in the right tone
options.explanation: Right. The page says good prompts can help keep both topic and tone inside limits.
